subject: [video] WP06: full probe link now clean after the lead fixes (147808 B, no -U)
body: Re-ran the integration against the current probe sources (lead review commit: exec-child runner, ___stderrp in probe/symbols.txt, new probe_core/probe_main): python3 sdk/make_tbds.py build/WP06/tbd, then clang -c with build_ios.sh CFLAGS for probe/av/probe_av.c + probe/{core,main,vt,img,audio}.c, then ld64.lld with all generated TBDs. Result: build/WP06/probe/n2vt_probe = Mach-O 64-bit arm64 executable, 147808 bytes, NOUNDEFS|DYLDLINK|TWOLEVEL|PIE, 160 imports, no -U exception needed. So the default build_ios.sh should get past the probe now (my 8da1712 fixed the stdio include and the Class->id receivers). WP06 suite unchanged: bash gpu/video/probe/av/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST WP06 PASS 111/111 (host oracle ASan+UBSan + zero-warning arm64 compile). Commits: 8da1712, 059691d, e8a163b, 81c0f91. Standing by for lead review of WP06.
